notes.title: Dev Update: Dash, Phone Booth, and a Hearty Thank You!
notes.content: [p]And with that, we're in September! Every turn of the month, I sit down and write one of these updates. And I always have no clue where the time went.[/p][p]Happy to report that I'm making progress on the game and finalizing the last of the plot. Lots of behind-the-scene work I've been tackling (that I can't talk about). I think we'll still make the 2025 release, but there is a possibility for early 2026 (sorry!)[/p][p]Anyways, here are some updates![/p][p][/p][h1]Meet Dash![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/3013ef824dbf3e87de07829f4fd42e540d78240a.png"][/img][/p][p]I've gotten lots of questions asking what the coins are for. Well Dash (the Haberdashery) has answers for you! They're an economy expert! They'll revitalize the local industry! And they're here to sell you hats (in exchange for your coins).[/p][p]Can't wait for you all to meet this dashing building :)[/p][p][i](note that you unfortunately can't date Dash, they're too invested in their 'work')[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Hello, hello?[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/5740e5abdffb897fb57007d7bb55eb26e763a381.png"][/img][/p][p]"Sorry, excuse me -- I'm on my phone."[/p][p]I added this phone booth to the game and well... I'm really excited for the dialogue related to the phone booth. I think it's truly the worst thing I've ever written (positive).[/p][p][/p][h1]And a big THANK YOU for your support![/h1][p]It's been a year since I moved back home to work on Building Relationships, and I just want to say that I'm incredibly grateful for each and everyone of you! I really needed a break from the corporate environment, and working on this game has been such a healing process for me. Making a game is not easy, finding an audience for the game is not easy, so I'm just really thankful for all the wishlists, nice messages, encouragements, etc.[/p][p]I hope the game will connect with you, in the same way it's allowed me to re-connect with myself.[/p][p][/p][h1][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][/img][/url] thank you for reading! [url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c5ec5506150b912052c5f6dc5d3f236beafac5c1.gif"][/img][/url][/h1]

notes.title: Dev Update: Updated Physics, Demo Achievements, Award Nomination, July Events!

BitSummit where the game was nominated for the "Innovative Outlaw Award"![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/7b997a6d1367c8d965af2d20332c11f04598952a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It was really cool to notes.title: Dev Update: Rhythm minigame, and... Pole Dancing?

notes.title: Dev Update: I added yearning to the game (+ SGF, Six One, Beyond Game Jam)
notes.content:
[p]Hello fellow structures! I hope you're all doing well :)[/p][p]Working on this game has been rocky at times, but I've been feeling a lot better about it! Progress is going smoothly, the pieces are slowly falling into place, and I'm so excited for y'all to experience the whole thing![/p][p]Anyways, here's some updates!![/p][p][/p][h1]Happy Pride Month![/h1][p]Building Relationships is a deeply [i]weird[/i] game. It's unserious at times, freaky at times -- but to me, it's a celebration of queer romance. So I hope that everyone is having a wonderful pride month![/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, here's a very naked look of the game from early on.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/2ddc7cbcffa7affac35be1ff04b368b4e978a9e7.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]I added yearning into the game![/h1][p]I've been working on the later sections of the game and I can't fully share everything I'm working on. So here's a look at the buildings yearning![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/e370cd958204d6036ba9db3de9dcc5b5fb172079.png"][/img][/p][p]Fun fact: The game currently crashes if I try to stop the yearning.[/p][p][/p][h1]We're part of Southeast Asian Games Showcase![/h1][p]Building Relationships was announced at last year's Summer Game Fest, and I'm so happy to be a part of SGF again this year (this time with Southeast Asian Games Showcase)![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Oe4Pm3nYGv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Don't forget to take a peek at all the awesome games in the showcase (here's the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/southeastasiangamesshowcase"]link[/url] to the steam event)[/p][p][/p][h1]Six One Indie[/h1][p]This was a couple of weeks ago, but Building Relationships was also in the Six One Indie Showcase! A bunch of unique indie games here as well :)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="adI4uizTYN4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Beyond Game Jam Talk[/h1][p]I'm also giving a talk later this month about making games with free assets, specifically on the joy & perspective that emerges when you're forced to be scrappy.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/7cfb2d2c1b37c0c7bae1831c51285fb0448c809e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you're a developer looking for a game jam to join, then check out the jam [url="https://itch.io/jam/beyond-game-jam"]here[/url].[/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/76503c4bea3edf6cef818995bc3c2f89dfa0e807.png[/img]

[h1]I showed the game and gave a talk at Indie Jam in Kuala Lumpur![/h1]

I was in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia last weekend and had a ton of fun :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/bebd4144a8215f913e12adf4bdff635f3aa2d00d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/a79065f15a7763c30d382bf41edd41bc6ec6b998.png[/img]

Also, check out this fan art I got from a fellow dev. Check out their game ([url=https://gdcvault.com/play/1035068/Independent-Games-Summit-Comedy-Through]Sedap[/url]) if you're looking for a cooking-combat adventure with a Southeast Asian flare!

[h1]Okay, what else have you been up to?[/h1]

[h2]Check out this interview I did for the game![/h2]

I did an [url=https://gamescout.co.uk/2025/04/interview-tan-ant-games-on-creating-a-dating-sim-where-you-are-the-love-shack-literally/]interview with Gamescout[/url] last month and wrote a little bit about the intention behind the game, hinting at the themes I want to tackle within the story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/6ae94ffd0b780c5ddf5018d87254cc0926b39582.jpg[/img]

[h2]Take a look at my reddit post :)[/h2]

I make fun lil videos every now and then! And it's been fun to just chat with the folks commenting on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CozyGamers/comments/1kbka7g/im_making_a_dating_sim_where_you_play_as_a_house/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web3x&utm_name=web3xcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button]post[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/4a59fb9dd6aad5821eaebc5a3d1e972b3dc388b7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Now for a bit of a vulnerable note[/h2]

It's been a bumpy month for me, progress often feels unpredictable -- sometimes I feel like I have this solo dev thing figured out and some days it feels like I'm stuck in unexplainable ways. There's so much I still have to figure out, so much that's stacked against me... some days the anxiety just gets to me and I just end up kinda lost.

Either way though, I'm trying new things to help get my mind on track. I stream my work on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/tanantgames]Twitch[/url] every now and then (it's a chill co-working session to make game dev feel less alone for me). And also I got these plants, which I think will fix me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/0ccb8cfb65a111388e31215eb843a06ddfab687e.png[/img]

Anyways, I'm still confident in delivering the game this year. I'm excited about where the story is headed, and I can't wait to hear all your thoughts on it :)

That's all I have this month! Bye!

notes.title: Dev Update: I added a very helpful tutorial & shared my Grindr screenshots
notes.content:
Hello fellow structures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/af5d9a57073f6a5e2fd0f090da75f6e6b877fffd.png[/img]
It's April which means, it's time for another monthly update!

March was a busy month for me! I was in Japan to expo Building Relationships as part of Tokyo Indie Games Summit and then in San Francisco to speak at this year's Game Developers Conference! It was a real honor to represent Thailand in the global stage, and it's also been nice to be away from the computer for a bit. 

[h1]So how's the progress?[/h1]

My forearm's been feeling a lot better (I got a standing desk and have been doing my stretches). And the overall break has just been nice for me to refresh and really figure out where I'm at. I'm still planning for a 2025 release, things are still on track. Turns out, when you try to mash two genres together, you end up having to program & design for two different games (who would've known LOL)

I'm also excited for where the story's headed. I have plans for the themes I want to tackle, but I'm giving it room to breathe and maneuver towards where it's supposed to.

[h1]How was Japan?[/h1]

Tokyo Indie Games Summit (TIGS) brought a lot of locals, it's a good reminder for me for which parts of the game is still slightly confusing to players. I've been taking feedback and made it more clear where you're supposed to go and what you're supposed to do (like during the cooking minigame).

Also, trying to explain the game in Japanese has inspired this little tutorial section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/893415c7214baf54d5703cc2a02dffaa051fcb48.jpg[/img]

[h1]How was Game Developers Conference?[/h1]

Honestly really good! I'm so thankful to have been selected as a speaker to talk about a niche topic like formulating comedy. I was very nervous, but had lots of people say really nice things about the talk to me :)

Coming up with the talk really made me think about my own process and forced me to verbalize how I approach each story beat. A lot of the things I've done so far has kind of been done through instinct, but I now have a much stronger pulse on my trajectory and what I need to do to get there.

Anyways, here's a slide from the talk where I showcase my experience with writing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/cd20c556dc16fabb0e25a942f43404a778c28033.jpg[/img]

Check out a clip from the talk [url=https://bsky.app/profile/tanatb.housefuckinggame.com/post/3lkojbk35zs25]here[/url].

I don't know if my talk will be made public, but I'm planning on turning it into a blog or devlog-style video at some point!

--

But that's it for now!

notes.title: Dev Update: New areas, more stories, TIGS (expo in Japan), & GDC!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow structures![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/af5d9a57073f6a5e2fd0f090da75f6e6b877fffd.png[/img]
It's February! Which means it's time for another dev update [i](that is definitely punctual and on-time).[/i] As we're creeping closer towards launch this year, I'm committing to providing monthly updates to keep you all in the loop!

[h2]So here's some stuff I've been working on[/h2]

[h3]Have you noticed the new art?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/50bed340ded57a059749a2a3864af3e5ed61ecbc.png[/img]

I've been writing more dialogue, shaping up more stories to tell within the world of Building Relationships. It's all coming from the heart, it's raw at times, and I'm excited for how you all will feel about it.

[h3]Speaking of more stories...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/c04b683016279efc4d9170549bee4d1c336ec47c.png[/img]
What's this? Broken pillars lying about? What's out there to uncover?

[h1]Now, onto some exciting news[/h1]

Building Relationships was included in The Gamer's list of indies to look out for in 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/6816e7993d50823183f0dbeb7d645a00e5e2e0af.jpg[/img]
Read the rest of the article (and all the great games featured) [url=https://www.thegamer.com/2025-is-a-big-year-for-big-games-but-dont-overlook-the-indies/]here[/url]!

[h3]Building Relationships is going to be showing in Tokyo![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/948f1177656f699ffdc3b4b6109743c053df60da.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/d7d2030682b02deb8b3220a09518756adf7c97a1.jpg[/img]
I'll be talking about structuring games for comedy (going through fundamentals and looking at humor through patterns). I used to go to GDC many times as a student, but back then, I was constantly overwhelmed from social anxiety and imposter syndrome... So it's very exciting for me to return as a speaker and also as someone who's learned to recognize those symptoms :)

notes.title: A Happy New Year that's definitely not late!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, I just wanted to say thank you for an amazing 2024![/h1]

The year started at a time when I was the most stressed, most burnt out I had ever been... But things started to come around for me as the game got accepted into showcases. I'm absolutely thankful for all of your support -- you have no idea how life-changing this has been. I ended up quitting my job, moving back home to pursue game development full-time. This all hasn't been easy, but I'm excited for when this game finally gets out there for y'all to play in full :)

[h2]In the meantime, here are some stats from the demo![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/1de3422d0ec52a0cbc306d097e42b879279df427.png[/img]

Like, did you know that most players are bottoms yearning for kindness? Who knew?

Anyways, if you haven't, please leave a review in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023890/Building_Relationships_Demo/]demo page![/url] I read every single one of them and try my best to incorporate your feedback into the full game :)

[h2]A few more stuff[/h2]
Here's a bunch of random cool stuff that happened!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/f44551492201a00a4be7a62781eab57ac05cf2ad.png[/img]
The game was featured in Debug, a magazine dedicated to indie games! Check out the issue [url=https://www.teamdebug.com/issue/7]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/3f3383a152590bb4e102c3cb50f462f82e5180f3.png[/img]
This time last year was when I first sketched the logo for the game. I removed the 'Prelude' subtitle at some point and here we are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/a306348cadc82a2c2c1486d779e6ec99d7bfd77e.png[/img]
I'm still hard at work on the game, turns out it takes a [b]lot[/b] of work to make a video game, lmao. In the meantime, have you seen the new screenshots I added to the steam page?

[h1]Here's to a wonderful 2025![/h1]

notes.title: The Demo Update Where I Addressed All Your Feedback
notes.content:
Hello fellow structures,

Just wanted to say thanks for everyone who's downloaded the demo, given it a try, and left a review on the demo page! This game means a lot to me, and it really warms my heart to receive so much love and support <3

I've heard the feedback, I've made the fixes and have uploaded an updated demo with the following fixes:
[list]
[*] The camera is easier to control now
[*] The camera now inverts properly (I think)
[*] The dating minigame no longer takes place in purgatory
[*] The dating minigame has been sped up and now includes a bit of a narrative hook
[*] You can now collect every fish in the journal (if you break the game a little)
[*] The music is not as loud (sorry)
[*] The jump sound is less annoying (it holds the note instead of sliding)
[*] Objective and Coin UI looks a little better now
[*] Misc localization fixes (I don't remember the whole list)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/7b54e5fbff1c78014d3922c23563ec0da9b55851.png[/img]

This has been such a wild year for me, I'm eternally grateful that I get a chance to pursue indie game development. I'm working hard on finishing the rest of the game, I hope you're excited for the nonsense I have left in store :)

notes.title: Building Relationships - July & August Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow structures!

The team has been busy working on the game! We've got more music in the works, areas being refurbished, and more! I've also been a lil bit busy [i]moving house[/i] across continents, so I missed the post for July (oops, sorry).

[h2]Steam Next Fest soon....?[/h2]

Things are progressing along nicely, and we'll hopefully have an improved demo ready for Steam Next Fest in October! Here's what we'll have in store:

[list]
[*] Revamped areas (like the beach), now with secret collectibles to find all over!
[*] Adjusted dialogue, now with character theme tunes for date-able structures!
[*] Movement improvements, making it harder to get stuck places (unless you'd want to be)!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/b53afd659a60bd804651dc88cd352fe2c5150788.png[/img]
[i]Look at this new pier, with chain physics and all![/i]

notes.title: Building Relationships - June Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow structures!

Can you believe that we announced Building Relationships a month ago? If you missed it, you can watch the Day of the Devs video here:

[previewyoutube=BExI_zQGD8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The reception has been overwhelming!! It was such a struggle trying to get any traction on the game and now it’s been featured in so many different places, yay!!!

[url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/platformer/building-relationships-is-like-a-short-hike-but-stupid-and-its-the-most-wholesomely-kinky-dating-sim-ive-ever-played/?utm_campaign=socialflow&utm_source=twitter.com&utm_content=gamesradar&utm_medium=social]Gamesradar[/url]

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2172588652?t=05h50m08s ]Nikoheart on twitch[/url]

[url=https://www.famitsu.com/article/202406/7509]Famitsu[/url]

We've also made it past 15k wishlists!!! It's an absolutely wild number for a small indie team, especially since it's my first game! Thank you so much to everyone who has wishlisted, it means the absolute world to me!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735780/ac3cba804a2ae1448f45a920f4956e36c08ffe84.jpg[/img]

Another exciting news is that Gina Loughlin is joining the Building Relationships team! She’s the composer and sound designer on Mail Time, and will be breathing so much life into the world of Building Relationships. Here’s a little sample of the new fishing minigame tune.

I’m also working on getting the game localized for launch! Currently, we’re targeting Chinese (Simplified), French, German, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish (European).

Otherwise, I’ve been pretty swamped with a lot of marketing work (thanking the people who played the demo during next fest, reaching out to press to build a list for review codes and what not).

That’s all for now, excited to share what else we’re cooking once it’s ready!

- Tanat

notes.title: Building Relationships is A Short Hike, but you are trying to chat up toy houses
notes.content:
Picture a himbo tent. Now, see if you can get your mind around the concept of a flirtatious windmill. What exactly are the key architectural qualities of dwellings you might wish to go to bed with? Actually, don’t bother stretching your grey matter – you can just play Building Relationships, which is sort of A Short Hike but also, Love Island for anthropomorphic toy houses. There are demos on Itch and Steam. Be warned that you will be asked whether you’re a rooftop or a bottom floor.
